Callout.Name: Warehouse Break-In
Callout.Message: Warehouse shutter forced, security reporting movement inside.
Callout.Advisory: One person believed inside, no vehicle seen.

Script.Line: The shutter has been up about an inch since midnight.
I have watched it on the camera and I am not going in.
There is somebody moving inside. I can see it on the screen.

Lines.Approach: Camera shows somebody inside and the shutter has been forced. He is still in there.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
